headline: Dangote Acquires 25 Percent Stake in Kenyan Oil Pipeline Network
summary: Dangote acquired a 25% stake in Kenya's oil pipeline network as part of efforts connected to his $16 billion mega-refinery.
why: Dangote is a prominent industrial conglomerate involved in major African infrastructure and energy projects.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Strategic infrastructure stakes alter regional oil distribution and refining operations.
